text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing. I invited 
Kawakami Princess along to watch a stage 
show at an amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
――Then let us dance, my Prince. Until the 
morning star rises in the sky!
(WAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Haaah~~, what a wonderful show that was~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What?! Thank you so much for bringing me 
along. I've been dying to see this show 
forever!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess's dress for dancing with her 
prince—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—...and those sharp steps executed with 
such grace! Those bold movements and 
powerful turns were simply splendid!
choice_data_list:
So it's the dance that matters, not the 
dress, huh

So it's the dance that matters, not the 
dress, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the dresses were wonderful too! 
My admiration for princesses originally 
started with the dresses the PreFies wore, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That sparkling, dazzling brilliance you 
couldn't take your eyes off pierced 
straight through my young heart... but 
still.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess's radiance isn't just about 
appearances!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Those who truly shine are the ones who 
spare no effort.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
After entering Tracen Academy, I came to 
realize that all the more—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how much pure grit today's 
princess poured in for the sake of that 
dance...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because of her hard work 
that she shines! I truly believe she is a 
real princess~!
choice_data_list: In that case, you're a princess too.

In that case, you're a princess too, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh my, stop that~~!! Praising me out of 
nowhere makes me blush!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Besides... the reason I can do my best is 
that you're always beside me—

Just then, the lights came back on over 
the darkened stage. And with graceful 
steps, the princess made her entrance.

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
The party is far from over! Now, let us 
dance together, everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, oh my! What a wonderfully fabulous 
encore performance this is!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I should also get right on it—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Mommy~, I don't get dancing at all~.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Me dancing is a bit... yeah, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Why isn't anyone dancing? When it's such a 
lovely invitation, too...
choice_data_list: Let's show them how it's done together!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh! When it comes to dancing, you're free 
to dance as your heart desires—freely and 
boldly, you know?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Big sister, your spin was so 
pretty... Just like a princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, little princess. Would you care to 
dance with me as well?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: But... I don't know how to dance...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, I shall teach you♪ Come now, 
princesses watching over there, you come 
join us too."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now then! Keep your eyes on me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I will show everyone the radiance I 
attained with you, as their princess...!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Doooossshhheeeeyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa~! Amazing, so amaaazing!

Lifting the children up boldly, Kawakami 
Princess began to dance with flair. The 
crowd cheered at her valiant presence.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Just as you guide me along the 
Princess Road, Trainer, tonight the two of 
us...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer-san, may I have your 
hand?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess, I shall show you that 
leading a dance is second nature to me♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Do not worry, we shall dance gently! I 
certainly have no intention of throwing 
you over my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it truly feels like a real ball♪

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wah! ...U-Um, Princess... Will you... 
dance with me too?

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! Let's dance together♪

Caught up in Kawakami Princess's cheerful 
dancing, the audience began dancing one 
after another. It became a wonderful 
memory.
